first_operational.notes: RFC 823 describes operational gateways in 1982 but this record does not yet establish the first deployment date.

roles: forward IP datagrams between heterogeneous networks
provide operational monitoring and fault reporting
addressing: Internet destination network/host addressing interpreted by gateway software; exact forwarding-table representation pending source-code excavation.
routing_or_forwarding: Receives an IP datagram, determines an output network/next hop, and queues it through network-specific output logic. GGP and related mechanisms participate in routing/control.
error_control: Best-effort Internet forwarding; network-specific links may provide their own error procedures. IP forwarding itself may discard packets when resources are unavailable.
flow_or_congestion_control: Output queue limits and packet drops are documented. Exact queue sizes and site-specific tuning require deeper extraction.

operations.monitoring: Gateway monitoring/status mechanisms with reporting to the Internet Network Operations Center (INOC).
operations.diagnostics: Network-specific status/error reporting plus gateway monitoring mechanisms; exact operator commands pending.
operations.failure_behavior: Packets can be discarded under resource/output-queue pressure; operational traps may be generated.
operations.operator_interface: INOC-facing monitoring path exists; console/software UI still to be reconstructed.

economics.payer_or_funder: DARPA-funded Internet research/operations environment; site-level ownership and circuit responsibility require separate records.

survival.provenance_notes: No surviving specimen claim is made until a museum/collection record can tie hardware to an actual BBN/DARPA gateway deployment.
